event.title: RAHP examination: ONDTF-GOV-006 emergency authority lifecycle and remedy
event.proposition: At ONDTF v1.0.0, examine whether a jurisdictional adoption invoking emergency authority can substantiate purpose, scope, duration, independent review, termination/revocation effects and redress under adverse and delayed conditions. Requirement ONDTF-GOV-006 is an accountable normative obligation, not evidence that any real implementation meets it. Assess negative countercases and evidence requirements; do not infer implementation conformance from the specification release.
